selected.how: Converting to int drops leading zeros; zfill only pads to len(a), failing if result is shorter than max(len(a), len(b)).
selected.what: Input '001', '111' yields '110' (len 3) instead of '110' (len 3), but '01', '111' yields '110' (len 3) instead of '110' (len 3). Wait, '01' vs '111': int('01')=1, int('111')=7, 1^7=6 ('110'). zfill(2) -> '10'. Expected '110'. Output is truncated.
